zh: 我通常七点起床，先去跑步，然后吃早饭。
old_en: I usually get up at seven, first run, then have breakfast.
new_en: I usually get up at seven, go for a run, and then have breakfast.

zh: 我晚上一般自己做饭，然后看一会儿剧。
old_en: I usually cook dinner first, then watch a show.
new_en: In the evening, I usually cook dinner and then watch a show for a while.

zh: 下班后我通常先做饭，吃完饭再看剧。
old_en: After work, I usually cook first, then eat and watch a show.
new_en: After work, I usually cook first, then eat and watch a show.

zh: 我睡前通常会先看半小时书，然后再睡。
old_en: Before bed, I usually read for half an hour first, then sleep.
new_en: Before bed, I usually read for half an hour and then sleep.

zh: 我一般十一点上床，先看半小时书再睡。
old_en: I usually go to bed at eleven, read for half an hour first.
new_en: I usually go to bed at eleven, read for half an hour first, and then sleep.

zh: 周末我通常会打扫房间，然后去超市。
old_en: On weekends, I usually clean the room first, then go to the supermarket.
new_en: On weekends, I usually clean the house and then go to the supermarket.

zh: 我一般周六上午打扫房间，下午再休息。
old_en: On Saturdays, I usually clean the room in the morning, then rest in the afternoon.
new_en: On Saturdays, I usually clean my room in the morning and rest in the afternoon.

zh: 我每天通常喝两杯咖啡，早上和下午各一杯。
old_en: I usually drink two cups of coffee every day, first in the morning, then in the afternoon.
new_en: I usually drink two cups of coffee each day, one in the morning and one in the afternoon.

zh: 我平时每天先喝一杯咖啡，下午再喝一杯。
old_en: I usually drink a cup of coffee in the morning, then another one in the afternoon every day.
new_en: I usually start my day with a cup of coffee, then have another one in the afternoon.

zh: 我通常十一点前上床，然后很快睡着。
old_en: I usually get into bed by eleven, then fall asleep quickly.
new_en: I usually go to bed before eleven and fall asleep quickly.

zh: 我下班通常顺路买菜，然后回家做饭。
old_en: I usually stop by the grocery store on my way home from work, then cook dinner.
new_en: I usually buy groceries on my way home from work and then cook dinner.

zh: 我通常周三晚上去健身房，练一个小时。
old_en: I usually go to the gym on Wednesday evenings, first do some warm-up exercises, then lift weights.
new_en: On Wednesday evenings, I usually go to the gym and work out for an hour.

zh: 我每天早上七点起床，先跑半小时，再回家洗澡。
old_en: I get up at seven every morning, first run for half an hour, then go home to shower.
new_en: I get up at seven every morning, run for half an hour, then shower at home.

zh: 我一般坐地铁上班，先听一会儿播客，然后看看新闻。
old_en: I usually take the subway to work, first listen to a podcast, then check the news.
new_en: I usually take the subway to work, listen to a podcast for a while, then read the news.

zh: 我平时通勤要一个小时，通常先听播客，再休息一会儿。
old_en: I usually spend an hour commuting, first listening to podcasts, then taking a break.
new_en: My commute takes an hour, I usually listen to podcasts first, then take a short break.

zh: 我中午通常和同事一起吃饭，然后散步。
old_en: I usually have lunch with my colleagues first, then take a walk.
new_en: I usually have lunch with my colleagues and then go for a walk.

zh: 午休时我一般和同事吃饭，吃完再喝杯咖啡。
old_en: I usually have lunch with colleagues first, then I drink a coffee.
new_en: During lunch break, I usually eat with my colleagues and then have a coffee.

zh: 我一般晚上十一点睡觉，早上七点起。
old_en: I usually go to bed at ten o'clock at night, then get up at seven in the morning.
new_en: I usually go to bed at eleven at night and get up at seven in the morning.

zh: 我一般下班先去超市，再坐车回家。
old_en: I usually go to the supermarket first, then take the bus home.
new_en: I usually go to the supermarket after work and then take the bus home.

zh: 我一般每周去三次健身房，先从周三开始。
old_en: I usually go to the gym three times a week, starting with Wednesdays first.
new_en: I usually go to the gym three times a week, starting from Wednesday.
